scope: Public offer search used by the CLI's `goma search` and `compare` commands.
notes: goma.gg is a Danish grocery price-comparison service. Its web client talks to a Supabase (PostgREST) backend at https://api.goma.gg.

The apikey below is the publishable, row-level-security-protected key the public web client ships with; it grants no more than anonymous browsing of goma.gg does. Override it with GOMA_API_KEY if it rotates.
goma.gg offers a sanctioned partner Data API (goma@goma.gg). These endpoints are not published as a stable public API and can change without notice.
The CLI sends p_log_search=false and p_session_id=null so its lookups stay out of goma.gg's search analytics.
redactions: No user account, session, or shopping-list data was captured; only anonymous catalogue search.

requests.purpose: Search grocery products and current offers across Danish chains

requestFields.p_search_term: free-text query, empty string allowed when filtering
requestFields.p_store_filter: array of store names as spelled above, or null
requestFields.p_department_filter: array of department names, or null
requestFields.p_category_filter: array of category names, or null
requestFields.p_labels_filter: array of label names, or null
requestFields.p_food_departments: array of department names, or null
requestFields.p_my_products_only: requires a signed-in goma.gg user; the CLI sends false
requestFields.p_previously_bought_only: requires a signed-in goma.gg user; the CLI sends false
requestFields.p_order_by_clause: one of: similarity DESC | current_price ASC NULLS LAST | current_price DESC NULLS LAST | is_on_sale DESC, discount_percentage DESC NULLS LAST, similarity DESC | product_name ASC NULLS LAST | product_name DESC NULLS LAST
requestFields.p_session_id: analytics session; the CLI sends null
requestFields.p_log_search: analytics opt-in; the CLI sends false
requestFields.p_source: analytics origin; the CLI sends null
